newsitem.title: CHINA: Cheung Kong flats at HK$6,148/sq ft.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong flats at HK$6,148/sq ft.

text.p: Cheung Kong Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it has priced the first batch of flats at its joint venture residential development at Ma On Shan in Shatin in the New Territories at an average of HK$6,148 per square foot.
Vista Paradiso, an joint venture project equally owned by Cheung Kong and Concord Land Development Co Ltd, has about 2,030 residential units.
"The first phase will have 1,012 units with an initial 204 units to be offered for sale soon," a sales manager for Cheung Kong told in a news conference.
Registration for potential buyers is set for July 21-23.
Selling will take place on July 26, the sales manager said.
"The first phase of the project with a floor area of about one million square feet is expected to generate a revenue of about HK$7.0 billion," said Katherine Hung, executive director of Cheung Kong.
This forecast included car parking space expected to be sold with the first phase, she added.
Vista Paradiso will have 1,500 parking spaces. Buyers of the first batch of units have the right to buy one space at between HK$500,000 and HK$520,000.
Cheung Kong officials called the flat prices were reasonable and attractive.
